title: core.org.created
description: An organization was created (signup or operator). Carries the settings a projection needs to interpret dates and money for it: `timezone` (IANA; account defaults it to Asia/Kolkata), `currency`, and `fiscal_year_start_month` (1-12; account defaults it to 4, April). `created_at` is the row's own creation instant, for a projection (console's identity fold, insights' `org_profile`) that has no other route back to account's schema (ADR-0000 §10: no cross-schema reads).
